definitions.explanation: Attached to a time expression to mark an approximate time or period. Written 〜{頃|ころ} in kanji; pronounced ごろ directly after a time word ({三時|さんじ}ごろ) and ころ after の, その or あの ({子供|こども}のころ, あのころ), but このごろ.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧ごろ⟦{届|とど}きますか→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{夕|ゆう}ごはん→夕ご飯：27817_yuugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦おいて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll be home around 6, so please have dinner ready.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
ごろ directly after a time word or question word (⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧ごろ, いつごろ, {今|いま}ごろ); ころ after ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ or ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧, where it is the noun ⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧ "time, days when" (⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ, ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ころ; see that entry). ⟦この{頃|ごろ}→この頃：01262_konogoro⟧ is usually read このごろ ("these days, lately").

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何|なん}{時|じ}ごろ (around what time)
- いつごろ (around when)
- {今|いま}ごろ (around now, by now)

WATCH OUT:
ごろ marks an approximate point in time; ⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧/くらい marks an approximate amount, including a length of time: ⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧ごろ⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧ (arrive around three) but ⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (take about three hours). ⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧ for a clock time is also heard in speech.
